Bill.BriefDescription: Changing the ignition interlock device revolving account from an appropriated account to a nonappropriated account.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the ignition interlock device revolving account;and amending RCW 46.68.340.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.68.340 and 2008 c 282 s 3 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The ignition interlock device revolving account is created in the((state treasury)) custody of the state treasurer. All receipts fromthe fee assessed under RCW 46.20.385(6) must be deposited into theaccount. ((Moneys in the account may be spent only afterappropriation.)) Expenditures from the account may be used only foradministering and operating the ignition interlock device revolvingaccount program. Only the director or the director's designees mayexpend money from the account. The account is subject to allotmentprocedures under chapter 43.88 RCW, but an appropriation is notrequired for expenditures.
